title: A charming place worth the visit.
text: This was a lovely day trip to Andorra! It was wonderful being able to travel to this delightful Country and experience something different from Spain. Our driver Roberto was fantastic and got us to and from safely. This was definitely worth it!
author: Karissa_V

title: A personal tour delightful
text: We booked weeks in advance. the day before there was a cancellation and we had it to ourselves. the driver took us in on the French side with wondeful views all the way to La Vella. Had lunch, saw all the sights and were back in the car just before it rained. there are three things to do in Andorra: Ski in the winter, hike in the summer and spend money
author: normaw806

title: Excellent trip added...
text: Excellent trip added another Country to our trip. Roberto excellent driver. Beautiful drive to Andora.
author: Michael_P

title: Unexpected pleasure
text:
Roberto made a long trip very enjoyable and interesting. He was very accommodating to our request on the returned trip in Barcelona
 It is probably best to go during the winter to appreciate the beauty of the town.

title: A must for a change of pace.
text: Highly recommend. Easy ride, beautiful place. Robert the driver was excellent.  Great shopping and food.
author: Ivan_P

title: Andorra
text: Perfect time to see Andorra quick and efficient .. beautiful views nice town .. Driver was very nice
author: monica_f

title: Lovely place to visit
text: We really enjoyed traveling to Andorra.  We passed through some lovely areas of Spain on the way and we enjoyed seeing the tiny country of Andorra.  Nacho, our driver, is a wonderful person who taught us so much about Catalonia history, culture, language, as well as information about Spain.  I guess that most people travel to Andorra to go shopping but we just wanted to see historical and cultural points of interest, such as medieval cities and important sites (not go shopping).  We saw very little of that and only at my insistence after seeing some postcards of Andorra.  This made the trip ev
author: Katherine_R
